documents.title: Aegis Search Engine Architecture & Design
documents.description: Complete architecture of Aegis: self-hosted web crawler, BM25 ranking algorithm, and zero-telemetry RAM processing.
documents.bodySnippet: Aegis Search Ultimate is an autonomous, private search engine. It features an integrated autonomous web crawler with rate-limiting, an in-memory inverted index, and dynamic sentence snippet extraction with PageRank link graph scoring.

documents.title: Express.js Routing and Middleware Guide
documents.description: Routing refers to determining how an application responds to a client request to a particular endpoint, which is a URI and a specific HTTP method.
documents.bodySnippet: Routing refers to how an application responds to a client request to a particular endpoint with an HTTP method (GET, POST, etc.) and a path. Middleware functions have access to the request object (req), the response object (res), and the next middleware function.

documents.title: MDN Web Docs: Privacy and Security in Web Applications
documents.description: Web application privacy practices, Referrer-Policy suppression, tracking prevention, Content Security Policy, and user data isolation.
documents.bodySnippet: Privacy on the web is paramount. Key defenses include strict Referrer-Policy: no-referrer, sanitizing URL parameters to remove tracking beacons (utm_source, fbclid, gclid), sandboxed iframe execution, and client-side encryption via the Web Cryptography API.

documents.title: The Rust Programming Language: Getting Started and Safety
documents.description: Rust is a systems programming language that provides memory safety without garbage collection, concurrency without data races, and zero-cost abstractions.
documents.bodySnippet: Rust empowers developers to build reliable and efficient software. By enforcing strict ownership and borrowing rules at compile time, Rust eliminates null pointer dereferences, buffer overflows, and concurrency races before runtime.
